createaerotools.tooltip.capsule_empty: Right-click a physical structure to store it.
createaerotools.tooltip.capsule_release: Right-click to place the stored structure.
createaerotools.message.capsule_empty: Aim at a physical structure to store it
createaerotools.message.capsule_not_stru: That block is not part of a physical structure
createaerotools.message.capsule_joined: Unjoin this structure from others before storing it
createaerotools.message.capsule_release_: Could not release the structure here
item.createaerotools.structure_capsule.t: Stores a _physical structure_ and places it back later.
Right-click a physical structure to _store_ it. Outgoing universal shafts are recovered; unjoin Sable joints to other crafts first.
Right-click a block or into the air to _release_ the stored structure.
createaerotools.tooltip.adv_capsule_empt: Right-click a Capsule Station, then a physical structure.
createaerotools.tooltip.adv_capsule_rele: Right-click a powered Capsule Station, then a place to release.
createaerotools.message.adv_capsule_need: Right-click a Capsule Station to release
createaerotools.message.adv_capsule_rele: Station selected — right-click a place to release
createaerotools.message.capsule_need_str: Not enough stress: need %s SU, have %s
createaerotools.message.capsule_station_: Bound station is gone; selection cleared
createaerotools.message.capsule_out_of_r: Left the station range; selection cleared
createaerotools.message.adv_capsule_incl: Cannot store the station with the structure
block.createaerotools.capsule_station.to: A kinetic _station_ for the advanced structure capsule.
Lets an _Advanced Structure Capsule_ store or release Sable-jointed or _universal-shaft_ structure groups.
item.createaerotools.advanced_structure_: Stores a whole group of _linked physical structures_.
Right-click a powered _Capsule Station_, then the structure to _store_ Sable-jointed or _universal-shaft_ crafts together. Shafts leaving the group are recovered.
Right-click a powered _Capsule Station_, then a place to _release_ the group.
createaerotools.tooltip.tool_gun_use: Right-click a physical structure to grab or release. Scroll to change distance. Sneak while grabbing to rotate. Left-click to freeze.
createaerotools.tooltip.tool_gun_air: Uses backtank air when worn; otherwise consumes durability.
item.createaerotools.physics_tool_gun.to: A survival _physics gun_ for grabbing and moving physical structures.
_Grab_ or _release_ the targeted structure. Scroll to change hold distance. Sneak to rotate.
_Freeze_ or unfreeze the structure in place.
createaerotools.message.drive_first: Select a second port to connect
createaerotools.message.drive_wrong_dime: Ports must be in the same dimension
createaerotools.message.pneumatic_mismat: Pneumatic ports can only connect to other pneumatic ports
block.createaerotools.pneumatic_port.too: After connecting with a universal shaft, adjust the _target length_. Brass uses redstone with a scale scroll; andesite uses a side length scroll.
Neighbor _redstone_ (0–15) maps to length using the side _signal scale_. When both ends are powered, the config chooses the higher or lower signal.
A _scroll slot_ appears on the sides for setting the target length.
createaerotools.message.drive_bad_angle: Port angle is too steep to connect
block.createaerotools.drive_port.tooltip: The _brass_ face takes a universal shaft; the _andesite_ face takes Create shafts for stress.
Right-click the brass faces of two ports to _connect_ them. Brass shafts spring back to the linked length; andesite shafts slide freely. Both _snap_ if pulled too far.
createaerotools.tooltip.drive_shaft_use: Right-click two ports to connect. Shift-right-click a port or the shaft to recover it.
item.createaerotools.drive_shaft.tooltip: A _Brass Universal Shaft_ whose length always returns toward the value at linking.
First click selects a port; second click _connects_ them and consumes one shaft.
Aim at a port or the shaft to _recover_ it.
createaerotools.tooltip.andesite_drive_s: Right-click two ports to connect. Slides freely; snaps past the maximum length. Shift-right-click to recover.
item.createaerotools.andesite_drive_shaf: An _Andesite Universal Shaft_ that slides freely with no spring return.
First click selects a port; second click _connects_ them and consumes one shaft.
Aim at a port or the shaft to _recover_ it.
